text:
“Lock my number in your phone,” he instructed, making me sigh because I was conflicted as hell. “Just do it, Ebony. I’m gon’ try to stay away from yo ass, but if you hit me, then that’s a different story. That’s a green light in my eyes to come for you full throttle. I don’t half step ‘bout shit, and I ain’t gon’ start with you. I’m placing the ball in your court.”

I was hesitant but handed him the phone so that he could add his number in. I didn’t want to use his name, so I saved it under work. That way, Anthony wouldn’t pay it any mind if he were to go through my phone for whatever reason.

Shy noticed it but laughed wryly with a shake of his head. I could tell he was slightly offended from the way his lips pressed together, but he didn’t speak on it.

“I have to go,” I told him as Peaches opened her front door.

“Aight. Don’t let that nigga stress you too much, shorty. I don’t need your edges missing and that pretty ass face looking old the next time I see you.”

“Bye, Shy.” I giggled while climbing out his truck.

I gave him a final wave then walked inside to an awaiting Peaches, pressing my back onto the door after locking it. Peaches was strolling away but then turned once she realized that I wasn’t following.

She grinned. “He got your ass, didn’t he?”

“Peaches, I cannot see him again. He's all in my fucking head. Over my body. Embedded in my pussy. Like, this nigga is everywhere.”

“Staking his muthafuckin’ claim! I already knew it, and you’re definitely seeing him again. If that man is willing to pick up the slack where yo nigga is falling short, then let him.”

“That’s the thing, he’s going to want more, and he admitted that.”

“Even better. Leave that lame and get with the winning team, bitch!” She threw her hands in the air before asking, “What’s so hard about that?”

“I can’t just leave Ant. Like, I know that Shy is practically perfect, but I'd feel like a fool if I leave my man and end up with worse. Better yet, if Shy and I don’t work because he doesn’t even want me for real. You know these niggas love a good chase. I can’t set myself up like that.”

“Damn, he got you big scared! I see you over there, shaking in yo thong. Wait, do you have one on, or did you fuck it up during foreplay?” She smirked knowingly.

“Actually, we didn’t have sex… he ate my pussy for breakfast, but that’s beside the point! This shit is messy, and I’ll be the one looking dumb in the end with my luck. I rather stick to what I know than to let him mind fuck me and dip.”

“So, that’s it? You're not fucking with Shy anymore?”

“No.” I shook my head vehemently, and she sucked her teeth.

“E, go home to your stupid ass nigga, and let him deal with you. I don’t have time for your shit on this lovely Sunday.” She fetched my keys from her entertainment center then tossed them to me. My mouth fell in shock because she was serious as hell about wanting me to leave. “Call me when you start using the sense that the good Lord gave you.”

“Are you really kicking me out, Peaches?”

“Yep. I have company coming over, and I need to cleanse my house of your negative energy before he arrives. The last thing I need is your simple ass vibes locking onto my spirit. Good day.”

“Wow. Fuck you too, then,” I muttered, storming out the door as she came to lock it behind me. “That’s why I’m wishing pregnancy and bad dick into your life!” I shouted as I climbed in my car.

“Oh, you hoe! See, now I have to cancel my dick appointment. You took it too far, Ebony!”

I flicked her off then started my car, backing out with a jerk before skirting down the street as I held in my laughter. Peaches didn’t play about her energy, so she was really going to cancel her dick appointment, which was fine with me. If I had to cut off my good wood, she wasn’t about to get any either.

The apartment was silent when I crept inside. I knew Anthony was home because his car was parked crooked out front. He must’ve come in drunken as hell, which worked out perfectly for me. I planned to change and creep out again because I doubted that I could look him in the face, knowing I'd just spent the night with the nigga that had been plaguing my thoughts for a while.

Hell, I was already wanting to go back there because my mood was shifting as I headed toward my bedroom. There should have been no reason for my own place to bring me so much negative energy. I was supposed to have peace and unwind here, but so much for that shit.

“Where the fuck you been?”

I jumped hard as hell then spun, locking eyes with Anthony as he stood in the doorway. Instead of answering him immediately, I took a moment to toss my keys and phone onto the dresser before kicking my shoes off.

“I was with Peaches.”

“How the fuck you get your phone back?”

I paused momentarily because Peaches hadn’t given me a lie for that, and it hadn’t even crossed my fucking mind.

“I just told you that I was with Peaches, Ant. Someone finally answered for her, so we met them at a gas station.”

“How did you know they answered for her? I was gone, so she couldn’t call you.”

“Nigga, doesn’t she have a car? She came here. I just took my own so that she wouldn’t have to drive me back home.”

“Okay, so why the fuck weren’t you here then?!” he stressed, following me as I headed for the closet.
